title: Rosmarinic acid ameliorates radiation-induced intestinal injury through PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB/MMP9 axis inhibition: From network pharmacology prediction to experimental validation.
authors: Li, Xiaoxue; Zhang, Jing; Dong, Yutong; Zhou, Zheng; Jiang, Beier; Min, Tianjiao; Song, Bin; Jin, Gang; Ma, Li; Li, Bolin; Yu, Luyao; He, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究迷迭香酸通过PI3K/AKT/NF-kB/MMP9轴缓解放射性肠损伤，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Radiation-induced intestinal injury (RIII) is a common complication following radiotherapy for abdominal and pelvic tumors, and there is currently a lack of highly effective and specific preventive or therapeutic drugs. Rosmarinic acid (RA), as a natural polyphenolic compound, possesses anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, but its specific therapeutic effects and mechanisms on RIII remain poorly understood. METHODS: Target prediction was performed using network pharmacology combined with molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation. Subsequently, in an in vivo experiment, C57BL/6 mice that subjected to 25 Gy of local abdominal irradiation were orally administered 200 mg/kg rosmarinic acid (RA). Intestinal injury was assessed by histological examination, serum biomarkers including intestinal fatty acid-binding protein (I-FABP), diamine oxidase (DAO), transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1), leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 5 (LGR5)-positive cells and Ki67 immunostaining, 16S rRNA sequencing, and Western blotting. Activation of the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B/nuclear factor-kappaB (PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB) signaling pathway was also detected. In vitro experiments, MODE-K cells were pre-treated with 25 muM RA before irradiation, and cell viability, malondialdehyde (MDA) levels, as well as the expression of target molecules at both mRNA and protein levels were analyzed. RESULTS: Network pharmacology identified MMP9, EGFR, and MMP2 as core targets of RA against RIII, which was further validated by the strong binding affinities observed in molecular docking and MD simulations. In vivo, RA ameliorated intestinal histopathological damage, maintained barrier integrity, reduced serum I‑FABP by 20% (P < 0.05) and DAO by 8.91% (P < 0.0001), increased TGF‑beta1 level by 84.65% (P < 0.001), inhibited villus breakage and crypt destruction, protected LGR5 + stem cells (increased by 253.34% compared with the radiation group, P < 0.0001), and decreased Ki67 + proliferating cells by 13.29% (P < 0.05). Additionally, RA partially reversed the radiation-induced loss of gut microbial diversity. In vitro, RA pretreatment increased the viability of irradiated MODE-K cells by 44.21% (P < 0.0001) and suppressed MDA levels by 58.61% (P < 0.0001). Meanwhile, RA downregulated the mRNA expression of IL-18, TNF-alpha, CASP3, MMP2, and MMP9 by 50.88%, 75.52%, 82.89%, 50.25%, and 60.07%, respectively (all P < 0.0001). Western blot results showed that radiation upregulated the protein levels of p‑PI3K, p‑AKT, p‑P65, and MMP9 in cells, while RA treatment markedly attenuated this upregulation of these proteins (P < 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, these data demonstrate that RA inhibits radiation‑induced activation of the PI3K/AKT/NF‑kappaB/MMP9 axis, reduces oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis, and preserves the intestinal stem cell niche. These data identify RA as a promising radioprotective candidate for the prevention and treatment of RIII.
abstract_zh: 背景：放射性肠损伤（RIII）是腹部和盆腔肿瘤放疗后常见的并发症，目前缺乏高效且特异性的预防或治疗药物。迷迭香酸（RA）作为一种天然多酚类化合物，具有抗炎和抗氧化活性，但其对RIII的具体治疗效果及机制尚不清楚。方法：采用网络药理学结合分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行靶点预测。随后，在体内实验中，对接受25 Gy局部腹部照射的C57BL/6小鼠口服给予200 mg/kg迷迭香酸（RA）。通过组织学检查、血清生物标志物（包括肠脂肪酸结合蛋白（I-FABP）、二胺氧化酶（DAO）、转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1））、富含亮氨酸重复序列G蛋白偶联受体5（LGR5）阳性细胞及Ki67免疫染色、16S rRNA测序和Western blotting评估肠损伤。同时检测磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B/核因子-κB（PI3K/AKT/NF-κB）信号通路的激活。在体外实验中，MODE-K细胞在照射前用25 μM RA预处理，分析细胞活力、丙二醛（MDA）水平以及靶分子在mRNA和蛋白水平的表达。结果：网络药理学鉴定出MMP9、EGFR和MMP2为RA抗RIII的核心靶点，分子对接和MD模拟中观察到的强结合亲和力进一步验证了这一点。在体内，RA改善了肠道组织病理损伤，维持了屏障完整性，使血清I-FABP降低20%（P < 0.05）、DAO降低8.91%（P < 0.0001），TGF-β1水平升高84.65%（P < 0.001），抑制了绒毛断裂和隐窝破坏，保护了LGR5+干细胞（与辐射组相比增加253.34%，P < 0.0001），并使Ki67+增殖细胞减少13.29%（P < 0.05）。此外，RA部分逆转了辐射引起的肠道微生物多样性丧失。在体外，RA预处理使受照射MODE-K细胞的活力增加44.21%（P < 0.0001），MDA水平抑制58.61%（P < 0.0001）。同时，RA分别下调IL-18、TNF-α、CASP3、MMP2和MMP9的mRNA表达50.88%、75.52%、82.89%、50.25%和60.07%（均P < 0.0001）。Western blot结果显示，辐射上调了细胞中p-PI3K、p-AKT、p-P65和MMP9的蛋白水平，而RA处理显著减弱了这些蛋白的上调（P < 0.01）。结论：综合来看，这些数据表明RA抑制了辐射诱导的PI3K/AKT/NF-κB/MMP9轴激活，减少了氧化应激、炎症和凋亡，并保护了肠道干细胞微环境。这些数据将RA确定为预防和治疗RIII的有前景的辐射防护候选药物。
